notes.title: A new game from scratch. (For the place of this game.)
notes.notes: [p]Having failed with the clicker, receiving many angry comments, and seeing almost zero statistics of daily visits, we realized that our idea was bad. Therefore, we decided to create a simple but interesting and completely free game. It WILL NOT have: dropped items, and any donation affecting the gameplay. The game was developed for 6 months by one programmer, we decided not to use other engines - although later we realized that we made a mistake - the development was very long and very difficult, but it was an invaluable programming experience. This game is very richly animated, its essence is in finding pairs of identical pictures, when passing a level, the player is guaranteed to receive one animated theme![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]The release date is not yet known, the game is in the testing stage. However, it will definitely be released in the summer! (For the place of this game.)[/p][p]Details on the video:[/p][previewyoutube="79YPUkebXYo;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Increased generation time
notes.notes: Dear players, we understand that this decision will not be liked by everyone who has been playing for a long time. But now the game is dying, the number of players is rapidly decreasing every day, and the buyers of items have completely left, since they are not able to sell what they bought. Therefore, in order to somehow save the game, we decided to increase the generation period from 2.5 hours to 48. In order to increase the speed, you just need to buy items from other players, and then your new item will be generated in 3 minutes, the amount of farm per day is thus not limited. Important! Also, don't forget that buying any item on the site increases the chance of getting a rare item in the next distribution by as much as 10 times! And buying a rare item, starting with silver, gives a 100% chance of getting the same item in 3 minutes!! In any case, thanks to everyone who played and plays, this is our simplest and first game and we did not bet on it. By the end of the month there will be a new drop list, and most likely this will be the very last update, in the future only bugs will be fixed when they are detected, but further development and improvement of the game will be stopped in order to switch to a new, more worthy and much more interesting game. Drop-Clicker was only a test project.

notes.title: New mechanics for accelerating drops.
notes.notes:
New mechanics for accelerating item drop when buying items in the market.
Now when buying any items, the next drop will occur in 3 minutes.
Also, a countdown line has appeared, and now you can see how long the next drop will be.
Buy, actively any items from other players and your daily farm will not be limited! Also, the standard distribution after 2.5 hours has also remained! Keep in mind that when buying, for example, a regular item from other players, you not only speed up the distribution, but also increase its chance of a rare drop by 10 times!!

notes.title: BALANSE
notes.notes:
We decided to leave the drop of items for 2.5 hours, but today we added a new mechanic - now the game will still encourage the purchase of rare items: starting from "Silver", adding a 100% chance of similar items dropping in the next distribution. That is, you buy, for example, a "Gold" item and in the next distribution you will get not a random one, but a "Gold" one with a 100% chance! Thus, items drop as from the very start of the game after 2.5 hours, it just increases the chance of getting rare items to 100% if the player buys them. This is done because we looked at the statistics and saw that there are almost no buyers. For example, there are no purchase orders for "Wonderful" items, which have a 1/10000% chance of being issued. With the new system, the player will be able to farm faster, as for example, he will buy a "Space" item for $ 1, get a second one, and sell two items for $ 2, buy two items and get $ 4, and so on, leveling up faster. BUT! ATTENTION! Keep in mind that by buying an item you only increase the probability of the CURRENT distribution, i.e. if you first buy one, for example, a fantastic example, and then a second, the 100% probability of getting a fantastic item does not extend to the second distribution following it. Therefore, buy one item, wait for the distribution, and only then buy the next one.

notes.title: A complete restart of the game! New mechanics and new gameplay!
notes.notes:
Now it's not just a clicker, but a full-fledged game that you can complete and level up. Each level gives you a unique skin that increases the chance of certain items falling out. Also, now buying VIP items allows you not only to collect them, but also increases the chance of getting rarer items by 3 times, for the next 100 generations.

New mechanics - now the game will still encourage the purchase of rare items: starting from silver, adding a 100% chance of getting similar ones in the next distribution. That is, you buy, for example, a gold item and in the next distribution you will get not a random one, but a gold one with a 100% chance! Thus, items drop as from the very start of the game after 2.5 hours, just the chance of getting rare items increases to 100% if the player buys them. This is done because we looked at the statistics and saw that there are almost no buyers. For example, there are no purchase orders for fantastic items that have a 1/10000% chance of being issued. With the new system, the player will be able to farm faster, since, for example, he will buy a space item for $ 1, get a second one, and sell two items for $ 2, buy two items and get $ 4, and so on, leveling up faster. BUT! ATTENTION! keep in mind that by buying an item you only increase the probability on the CURRENT distribution, i.e. if you first buy one, for example, a fantastic example, and then the second, the probability of 100% for the distribution of a fantastic item does not extend to the second distribution following it. Therefore, buy one item, wait for the distribution, and only then buy the next one.

notes.title: BIG CHRISTMAS ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.notes:
Good afternoon dear players!

   -The year 2024 is coming to an end, and Christmas is approaching, and in honor of this event we have prepared an interface update - we added a new New Year's skin.

   -But the most important thing is not that, we have prepared a gift for you: a new rotation of New Year's items, where absolutely every item, even the most frequent one, is animated! More than 17 new!, truly beautiful festive, live, animated items are waiting for you in the game from 06.12.2024 to 15.01.2025! Collect the whole collection!

- But do not rush to put them on the trading floor immediately when they fall out, because even this is not the most important news, we are openly announcing a full restart of the game for the first time! We can't show the accumulated material yet, but we will try to show the first video trailers and screenshots of the new one by the New Year, not just a "click-through" - but a truly full-fledged game with a capital letter! Which can be played, which can be passed and in which you can even swing your level, and most importantly, the drop-down items will not just be collectible cards, but will finally be involved! What exactly it will be is still a big secret and a surprise, but keep an eye out for new announcements so as not to miss all the details :)
